sourceText.he: וְאִם לָאו — יִתְכַּסֶּה בְּמַיִם וְיִקְרָא. וַהֲרֵי לִבּוֹ רוֹאֶה אֶת הָעֶרְוָה?

positions.claim: one who cannot cover himself in time covers himself in the water and recites
reciting so is problematic since his heart sees his nakedness with no barrier
positions.basis: the rule that the heart may not see the nakedness during Shema
